content.title: Oscars 2026: Best and worst red carpet looks from nominees: Timothée Chalamet, Emma Stone, Michael B. Jordan and more
content.text: It’s just about time for the Oscars again, with this year’s ceremony coming tonight — Sunday, March 15. It’ll be the biggest night of awards season, where stars and movies from last year will be honoured with major accolades like best picture, best director and more.But before we get to the official ceremony and this year’s red carpet, let’s take a look back at some of the fashion this year’s nominees have worn at past Oscars. Some of the nominated celebrities haven’t attended the Oscars yet, or have only been once, such as Jacob Elordi, Rose Byrne, Renate Reinsve and Elle Fanning. But others — including Timothée Chalamet, Emma Stone and Kate Hudson — aren’t newbies to the biggest night in film.When are the 2026 Oscars?This year, the 98th annual Academy Awards will be held on Sunday, March 15, 2026. Hosted by Conan O’Brien at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles, Calif., the ceremony will begin at 7 p.m. EST, with a red carpet pre-show beginning at 6:30 p.m.Keep scrolling for some of the best and worst red carpet looks we’ve seen this year’s nominees wear at past Oscars.1. Timothée ChalametChalamet is up for the Actor in a Leading Role award for his portrayal of Marty Mauser in the Josh Safdie-directed film, Marty Supreme. The 30-year-old actor starred in the table tennis flick alongside celebrities like Gwyneth Paltrow and Canadian businessman Kevin O’Leary.Oscar nominations: 4Best red carpet look: 2022Timothée Chalamet at the 2022 Oscars. (Gilbert Flores/Variety/Penske Media via Getty Images)(Variety via Getty Images)Chalamet’s red carpet look in 2022 is one that, year after year, makes Yahoo Canada’s list of the best Oscars looks of all time. The cropped Louis Vuitton blazer with lace overlay was ahead of its time, and the nine pieces of white gold from Cartier took his style to the next level. Plus, going shirtless was a daring move for what’s typically a safe red carpet.Worst red carpet look: 2020Timothée Chalamet at the 2020 Oscars. (P. Lehman/Future Publishing via Getty Images)(P. Lehman via Getty Images)His 2020 Oscars look erred on the side of Paw Patrol, though. The navy blue jumpsuit from Prada could’ve doubled as a mascot’s uniform for the children’s TV show, and slicking back his usually curly, full hair was a fashion crime for the evening.2. Emma StoneStone seeks her third Academy Award this year, which would put her in the ranks of great artists like Katharine Hepburn and Frances McDormand. The 37-year-old star is nominated for best actress for her work in Bugonia, in which she plays a powerful CEO who’s kidnapped by conspiracy theorists.Oscar nominations: 7Best red carpet look: 2024Emma Stone at the 2024 Oscars. (Gilbert Flores/Variety via Getty Images)(Gilbert Flores via Getty Images)Stone was a red carpet dream at the 2024 Oscars, wearing a strapless teal dress from Louis Vuitton that featured a wide peplum skirt. Paired with a 30-carat yellow diamond necklace, the ensemble was a fit for a winner, as Stone took the stage later that night to accept the best actress award for her work in Poor Things.Worst red carpet look: 2018Emma Stone at the 2018 Oscars. (Andrew H Walker/WWD/Penske Media via Getty Images)(WWD via Getty Images)Six years prior, she broke red carpet tradition with a Louis Vuitton pantsuit for the 2018 Oscars. It’s not that she wore a bad look per se, but the blue navy slacks make the outfit look like she just left the office to attend the Academy Awards.3. Jessie BuckleyIrish actress Jessie Buckley has been a best actress favourite this awards season, after her work in Chloé Zhao’s Hamnet earned her a Golden Globe, a BAFTA and an Actor Awards win. In the film, the 36-year-old actress stars alongside Paul Mescal, in which they play Agnes and William Shakespeare.Oscar Nominations: 2Best red carpet look: 2023Jessie Buckley at the 2023 Oscars. (Gilbert Flores/Variety via Getty Images)(Gilbert Flores via Getty Images)Buckley turned heads at the 2023 Oscars, opting for a stunning long-sleeve Rodarte gown that was essentially Joan of Arc entering her gothic era. The sheer black piece featured floral embroidery and large puffy shoulders, which the actress paired with a striking fiery red bob.Worst red carpet look: 2022Jessie Buckley at the 2022 Oscars. (David Livingston/Getty Images)(David Livingston via Getty Images)Her red carpet look in 2022 wasn’t necessarily terrible; the pastel pink Erdem gown was minimalist and paid adequate homage to the stars of the 1920s and ‘30s. But it was a dress that washed her out, and the orange, layered bowl-cut hairstyle she sported for her first Oscars night was a questionable styling choice.4. Kate HudsonHudson was a surprise Actress in a Leading Role nominee when the Academy announced this year’s nominations on Jan. 22. The 46-year-old actress was recognized for her portrayal of Claire Sardina in Song Sung Blue, in which she stars alongside Hugh Jackman in a Neil Diamond tribute band.Oscar nominations: 2Best red carpet look: 2014Kate Hudson at the 2014 Oscars. (Jeffrey Mayer/WireImage)(Jeffrey Mayer via Getty Images)Hudson hasn’t been afraid to bring her fashion A-game to the Oscars over the years, but the dress she wore in 2014 is certainly one for the books. Attending as a presenter that year, she wore a glamorous Atelier Versace gown that featured a low-cut, satin design, with a cape and woven waist elements that left her looking expensive.Worst red carpet look: 2001Kate Hudson at the 2001 Oscars. (SGranitz/WireImage)(Steve Granitz via Getty Images)Too much was happening in her look for the Oscars red carpet in 2001. Hudson — who was nominated for Best Actress that year for her work in Almost Famous — wore a Stella McCartney lilac-coloured dress that featured rhinestones, an open back, plus a capelet with a high neck and fringe trim. Her curly hairstyle also clashed with the look, taking away too much attention from what could’ve been a fine outfit.5. Michael B. JordanWith his shock win at the Actor Awards on March 1, Jordan upset the race for this year’s best actor Oscar. The 39-year-old star is nominated for his performance in Sinners, in which he plays a dual role as the Smokestack Twins in the vampire horror.Oscar nominations: 1Best red carpet look: 2019Michael B. Jordan and Donna Jordan at the 2019 Oscars. (Rick Rowell via Getty Images)(Rick Rowell via Getty Images)Jordan was already a red carpet winner in 2019 when he sweetly showed up with his mom as his date, but when it comes to his fashion, the actor looked suave and stylish for the night. He wore a look from Tom Ford that featured a navy velvet suit jacket with a pair of black pants, pairing the outfit with a black bowtie and jewelry from Piaget.Worst red carpet look: 2014Michael B. Jordan at the 2014 Oscars. (Dan MacMedan/WireImage)(Dan MacMedan via Getty Images)In 2014, Jordan wore a Givenchy suit that was aptly fitted and looked fine from the waist up. The Piaget watch and collar piece from the Gentleman Collection by Dave Thomas were welcome accessories, but the gold-plated shoes were a tacky distraction that should’ve been left in the wardrobe.6. Ethan HawkeRichard Linklater’s Blue Moon didn’t make the most noise this awards season, but critics and audiences loved Hawke’s performance in the biographical film. The 55-year-old actor is one of the five best actor nominees at the 2026 Oscars, recognized for his portrayal of lyricist Lorenz Hart.Oscar nominations: 5Best red carpet look: 2014Ethan Hawke at the 2014 Oscars. (Jeff Vespa/WireImage)(Jeff Vespa via Getty Images)Hawke might not be the first person you think of when it comes to red carpet fashion, but he did clean up well for the 2014 ceremony. The actor wore a well-fitted classic tuxedo from Dior that was predictable, but it had him looking striking for the night. Plus, it’s hard not to look top-notch when you’re arriving with Julie Delpy by your side.Worst red carpet look: 2000Uma Thurman & Ethan Hawke (Photo by Jeffrey Mayer/WireImage)(Jeffrey Mayer via Getty Images)Unfortunately, his red carpet outfit in 2000 was one that looked forgettable, frumpy and not worthy of being next to the show-stopping Uma Thurman that night.7. Amy MadiganMadigan has received high praise for her role in the Zach Cregger-directed horror, Weapons. Starring as Gladys in the movie, the 75-year-old actress also won the supporting actress awards at this year’s Golden Globes and Actor Awards.Oscar nominations: 2Best red carpet look: 2001Amy Madigan and Ed Harris at the 2001 Oscars. (Ron Galella, Ltd./Ron Galella Collection via Getty Images)(Ron Galella, Ltd. via Getty Images)Not many people can make a pantsuit work on the red carpet, but Madigan looked expensive and powerful at the Oscars in 2001. She paired the look with silver hoop earrings, a black clutch and teal-tinted sunglasses that matched the shirt of her husband, Ed Harris.Worst red carpet look: 1996Amy Madigan and Ed Harris at the 1996 Oscars. (Ron Galella, Ltd./Ron Galella Collection via Getty Images)(Ron Galella, Ltd. via Getty Images)But the overcoat dress she wore in 1996 offered up less glamour than was necessary for the red carpet. It was a well-tailored piece and featured rhinestones on the lapels, but she looked more suited for a funeral than an awards ceremony that night.8. Diane WarrenWarren snagged her 17th Oscar nomination this awards season, earning a best original song nod for “Dear Me.” The 69-year-old songwriter penned the tune, performed by Kesha, for the documentary, Diane Warren: Relentless. Will it finally be her time to score an Academy Award?Oscar nominations: 17Best red carpet look: 2020Diane Warren at the 2020 Oscars. (Jeff Kravitz/FilmMagic)(Jeff Kravitz via Getty Images)It’s no question that Warren loves a red carpet blazer, and while the songwriter doesn’t often switch up that silhouette, the ensemble she wore in 2020 looked as though she was finally going to break her Oscars curse. She opted for a silver sequinned blazer and black trousers, staying on brand with a treble clef choker.Worst red carpet look: 2025Diane Warren at the 2025 Oscars. (Gregg DeGuire/Penske Media via Getty Images)(Gregg DeGuire via Getty Images)In 2025, she went for an all-navy look with an oversized white shirt underneath. It could’ve been an OK ensemble, but the matching treble clef tie connected to a choker makes the entire outfit appear confusing.Let us know what you think by emailing us or threading us @yahoocanada.
